about: Hand-worked answers for electro and delivery_area, written BEFORE running the engine on these scenes (blind). Inputs used: wall lengths, joints, per-wall camera coverage and laser-read openings from the build summaries; standing-obstacle and overhead positions NOT looked at, so any obstacle-driven difference is expected to show up as a miss here.

Unexplored end S.a is 16.5 ft from the meter (< every profile's reach incl. A's 15? no: A 15 < 16.5-0.3) -> public/C block reject on S.a; A/B/strictest never reject. So manual_review for all five.
